entries.title: GCC hospitality data analytics non-compete
entries.summary: Supplier and its Affiliates are prohibited from providing data analytics, AI, or revenue management services to any hospitality business in the GCC region during the term and for 18 months thereafter.
entries.quote: In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.

relatedClauses.quote: "Hospitality Business" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity.
"Restricted Period" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

"GCC" means the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman.

For the purposes of Clause 12.1, services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.
The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.

entries.notes: Calculated end date of 14 September 2029 is based on the 18-month post-termination restriction period following the agreement's scheduled expiration on 14 March 2028.

entries.title: Mutual staff non-solicit
entries.summary: Neither party may solicit employees of the other party who were directly involved in the services during the term and for 12 months thereafter.
entries.quote: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services, save through general advertisements not targeted at such employees.

relatedClauses.quote: The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.

entries.notes: This is a routine mutual solicitation restriction that applies to personnel directly involved in the services.

entries.title: UAE Guest Data offshore restriction
entries.summary: Supplier is prohibited from transferring Guest Data outside the UAE without consent, and any access from India must be remote-only from UAE-hosted environments.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall not transfer Guest Data outside the UAE without the Client's prior written consent. Any Guest Data accessed from India shall be accessed remotely from UAE-hosted environments only.

relatedClauses.quote: "Guest Data" means any personal data relating to guests, prospective guests or loyalty members of the Client.

entries.notes: Strict restriction on hosting or transferring Guest Data outside UAE. Indian operations are restricted to remote access of UAE-hosted environments.

entries.title: Guest Data incident notification
entries.summary: Supplier must notify Al Noor within 48 hours of any unauthorized personal data access or incident involving Guest Data.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall process Guest Data only on the documented instructions of the Client, implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, and notify the Client without undue delay (and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours) of any personal data breach.
entries.notes: Requires prompt notification to the client within 48 hours of any personal data incident.

entries.title: Professional Indemnity Insurance Requirement
entries.summary: Supplier is required to maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than USD 500,000 per claim for the term and 1 year thereafter.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than USD 500,000 per claim for the Term and one (1) year thereafter.
entries.notes: The professional indemnity insurance must be maintained at a minimum of USD 500,000 during the term and for 1 year after the contract ends.

entries.title: Subcontracting restriction
entries.summary: Supplier is prohibited from subcontracting any portion of the services without prior written consent from Al Noor.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Client's prior written consent. The Supplier remains responsible for the acts and omissions of its subcontractors.
entries.notes: Requires explicit written consent from the client before subcontracting any part of the services.
